column1: # The ROUTINE registry — every routine the portal knows, measured or not yet.
# Columns: lane <TAB> routine <TAB> class <TAB> population <TAB> exercises
#   lane        the bench directory (bench/<lane>) or package lane that prints the row
#   population  engine  — a synthetic program that measures the ENGINE (informational)
#               stdlib  — a routine of the standard library, on a workload a program runs
#               library:<name> — a `pub fn` of a shipped library

#                 own data layout and sizes (the program itself is never run by the bench)
